headline: 書評與舞台劇兩則速報
context: 倫敦漢普斯特德劇院（Hampstead Theatre）推出新製作《Springwood》，由 Robert Lindsay 飾演美國總統羅斯福（Franklin D Roosevelt），重現英王喬治六世（King George VI）訪美的歷史。另一則書評介紹傳記《International Freak》，寫的是博弈論學者兼反種族隔離運動者 Robin Farquharson，被稱為「英國版 Timothy Leary」。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Robin Farquharson was a prize-winning game theorist, anti-apartheid activist and countercultural chaos merchant Even as an undergraduate, Robin Farquharson was famous for being erratic. He provoked anxiety and goodwill in equal measure. His aim in life, according to an anonymous writer in an Oxford student newspaper, was “to become a contradiction in terms. Since last October, he has been cutting friends in the street; sleeping alternate nights in mysterious George Street garrets and obscure collegiate crypts.” The profile described his soul as “dogged, indomitable” and “fierce, incompatible”. Maybe. Later to become a prize-winning game theorist often hailed as a genius, he died aged just 42 in a squat fire on April Fools’ Day 1973. The poet Aidan Andrew Dun called him an “outsider among outsiders … a luminous ruin of a man”. For anti-psychiatrist RD Laing, he was “very intelligent and totally out of his fucking mind”. Farquharson once joked he had been born a member of the master race in South Africa. He wasn’t entirely wrong. His father had founded a distinguished law firm in Pretoria; high-up politicians would regularly come over for dinner. He attended elite private schools – future pupils included the novelist Wilbur Smith and Elon Musk – and got himself a pilot’s licence even before, barely 16, he entered university. Later at Oxford he studied PPE, befriended Bertrand Russell and Rupert Murdoch (a self-declared Marxist at the time), and shared digs with future chancellor of the exchequer Nigel Lawson. Intellectually he was regarded as high-wattage but, about to land a starry All Souls College fellowship, he wrecked his chances by phoning the college warden to tell him he had a message from God he needed to share. sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Hampstead theatre, London Robert Lindsay excels as Franklin D Roosevelt in Richard Nelson’s fascinating retelling of King George VI’s diplomatic visit in 1939 The 2012 film Hyde Park on Hudson – fictionalising a 1939 visit by King George VI and his queen Elizabeth to a summer home of President Franklin D Roosevelt and first lady Eleanor – was a modest success, seen (more happily by Republicans than Democrats) as an oblique take on the Clintons: the president hiding a complex private life while his wife was more intelligent and independent than some folk liked. The film’s screenwriter Richard Nelson treats the material for the third time (he also did a 2009 BBC radio drama) in this related but rebooted stage play, providing a fascinating example of how context can change content. Inflected by this week’s 250th birthday of American independence, a play in which a monarch comes crown in hand on a Foreign Office mission to secure American support for the impending European war also has resonances of the shakiness of Nato under President Trump whom King Charles recently met on a state visit . thread_text:
書評與舞台劇：博弈論奇人傳記與英王訪美歷史劇

倫敦漢普斯特德劇院（Hampstead Theatre）的新製作《Springwood》，由 Robert Lindsay 飾演美國總統富蘭克林·羅斯福（Franklin D Roosevelt），以英王喬治六世（King George VI）出訪美國為背景。評論稱這是劇作家 Richard Nelson 的「迷人重述」。

傳記《International Freak》書寫 Robin Farquharson，他身兼博弈論得獎學者、反種族隔離活動人士與反文化圈子的重要人物，評論稱他是「英國版的 Timothy Leary」。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 7 月 1 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
書評與舞台劇：博弈論奇人傳記與英王訪美歷史劇

倫敦漢普斯特德劇院的新製作《Springwood》以英王喬治六世訪問美國為背景，Robert Lindsay 飾演富蘭克林·羅斯福。劇作家 Richard Nelson 撰寫，評論稱這是一個「迷人的歷史重述」。

傳記《International Freak》（M Syd Rosen 著）書寫博弈論學者 Robin Farquharson，他同時也是反種族隔離活動人士與反文化運動的重要人物，評論稱他是「英國版的 Timothy Leary」。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 7 月 1 日發佈的報導。
voice_text:
倫敦有一部新舞台劇在上演，講英王喬治六世訪問美國的故事。Robert Lindsay 飾演美國總統羅斯福，評論形容這是「迷人的歷史重述」。

書評方面，傳記《International Freak》寫的是 Robin Farquharson——一個博弈論學者出身、後來投入反種族隔離運動和反文化圈子的人物。評論稱他是「英國版的 Timothy Leary」。
